title: Geometric and algebraic inference in humans and neural networks
summary: Human and neural-network experiments support distinct geometric and algebraic inference strategies; causal interventions identify separate representational-geometry and selective-attention mechanisms in the neural models, without asserting the same causal mechanism in humans.
ai_technology: transformers trained from scratch and LLMs are tested alongside human transitive-inference experiments; model interventions perturb proposed mechanisms.
